_comment: Labeled probe queries for scripts/kb_score_probe.py. Each query is tagged on_domain (the KB — geology/botany/bushcraft/fishing — SHOULD have a relevant chunk) or off_domain (it should NOT; a good floor returns empty). The harness reports the score distribution per label so kb.min_score can be picked from data, not two hand-probes. Add queries as the corpus grows.
on_domain: how does decompression melting produce magma at mid-ocean ridges
